Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”) for D -PLEX₁₀₀ for the prevention of surgical site infections (“SSIs”) in patients undergoing abdominal colorectal surgery, supported by positive results from the pivotal Phase 3 SHIELD II trial, which met its primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints and demonstrated a 60% relative risk reduction in SSIs compared to standard of care (p=0.0013). ● Subsequent to quarter end, on July 27, 2026, the FDA accepted D-PLEX₁₀₀ NDA submission and granted Priority Review, with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) goal date of November 28, 2026, approximately one quarter ahead of the Company’s previously communicated first quarter 2027 guidance.
